title: Fitness and Exercise for People With Arthritis
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to develop and evaluate a progressive, land-based exercise program, that includes muscular and aerobic conditioning, resistance and stabilization exercises and balance training, for persons with arthritis.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Self-reported doctor-diagnosed arthritis
* No physical limitations precluding exercise participation
* Negative screen for CVD (PAR-Q)
* Age 20+
* English or Spanish speaking

Exclusion Criteria:

* Presence of any condition for which exercise is contraindicated
* Physical inability to complete exercise program
